Arrows are crucial to show the flow. I'll define an arrowhead in the section using a marker. Each connection between components should have a path with the marker-end attribute pointing to the arrowhead.

Check for any unclosed tags. The previous error was a mismatched tag, so I'll go through each element to ensure every opening tag has a closing tag. For example, each should have a , and all paths and text elements are properly closed.
Use snake_case for group IDs like input_embedding, positional_encoding, etc. Connect them with lines using elements and apply the arrowhead. Also, make sure the encoder and decoder layers are grouped correctly, maybe with multiple layers indicated.
Finally, validate the XML structure. Maybe the previous error was from a missing closing tag on a path or text element. I'll double-check each element's syntax. Once everything is in place, output the SVG without any markdown, just the raw XML.
